Well the experience I have right now is pretty similar to the sandbox you sent.

In the example you sent there are brands. Right now they are a taxonomy of each product.
So in your example, if you would like to display the logo next to each brand in the refinementlist, how would this be done?

I have indexed another indices containing all the brands. This contains logo, description, etc about each brand. I want to display this information in the refinementlist for my main indices (instant_search in your example).

I've dont know where to start on this functionality so I dont have any code to show you for it, all i've done is index all brands separately.
